item.title: Micro Drip Emitters for Balcony Herbs: A Practical Setup Guide
item.description: Disclosure: This guide contains affiliate links. We earn a commission if you purchase through these links at no extra cost to you. See affiliate disclosure for details. Micro drip emitters work well for balcony herbs when the system is small, visible, and easy to tune. The mistake is treating every herb pot like the same tiny container. Basil, parsley, rosemary, thyme, mint, and oregano do not want one shared watering answer.

item.title: Drip Irrigation for Balcony Herb Gardens
item.description: Herb gardens are the gateway drug of balcony gardening. They smell amazing, save money on grocery store bundles, and most grow fast enough to reward beginners within weeks. But herbs are also surprisingly picky about water — and different herbs want opposite things. Basil wilts if you blink at it wrong. Rosemary and thyme thrive on neglect. Mint tries to take over the world if you give it too much moisture.
